rows.section: New Jersey state unemployment insurance (employer)
rows.label: Taxable wage base (per employee, per year)
rows.note: New Jersey new employers pay 2.6825% UI plus 0.1175% workforce development (2.8%). They also pay 0.5% temporary disability insurance on the same wages, which is not included here. Employees pay their own UI, disability and family leave shares.
rows.source_title: New Jersey LWD Division of Employer Accounts, Rate Information

rows.section: New Jersey corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Corporation Business Tax rate (taxable income over $100,000)
rows.note: Statutory rate unchanged for 2026; figure from the 2025 CBT-100 instructions (periods ending July 31, 2025 to June 30, 2026), the latest published.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: 2025 CBT-100 General Instructions for New Jersey Corporation Business Tax Return

rows.section: New Jersey corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Corporation Business Tax rate (taxable income $50,001 to $100,000)
rows.note: Applies to the entire taxable net income when it is over $50,000 and not over $100,000.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: 2025 CBT-100 General Instructions for New Jersey Corporation Business Tax Return

rows.section: New Jersey corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Corporation Business Tax rate (taxable income $50,000 or less)
rows.note: Applies to the entire taxable net income when it is $50,000 or less.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: 2025 CBT-100 General Instructions for New Jersey Corporation Business Tax Return

rows.section: New Jersey corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Corporate Transit Fee (additional tax on taxable income over $10 million)
rows.note: Additional 2.5% on the whole taxable net income when it exceeds $10 million, for privilege periods beginning 2024 through 2028; not for public utilities or NJ S corporations.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: Corporate Transit Fee (last updated 06/02/25)

rows.section: New Jersey corporate income and franchise taxes
rows.label: Minimum tax
rows.value: $500 to $2,000 depending on New Jersey gross receipts ($2,000 for members of groups with $5 million or more payroll)
rows.note: $500 under $100,000 of NJ gross receipts; $750, $1,000, $1,500 in middle tiers; $2,000 at $1,000,000 or more.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: 2025 CBT-100 General Instructions for New Jersey Corporation Business Tax Return

rows.section: New Jersey property tax: state rules
rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: Counties, municipalities and school districts (collected by the municipality); the State receives none of it
rows.note: Assessed at 100% of true value in all 21 counties.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: How My Property is Valued (last updated 08/12/25)

rows.section: New Jersey property tax: state rules
rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: NJ Division of Taxation, Property Administration (Local Property Tax Administration)
rows.note: Monitors local assessors and the county boards of taxation.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: Local Property Administration

rows.section: New Jersey property tax: state rules
rows.label: Municipal property tax levy cap
rows.note: Annual levy growth limit (with statutory exclusions); can be exceeded by referendum. A separate 2.5% appropriation cap also applies.
rows.source_title: NJ Department of Community Affairs, Division of Local Government Services: Local Finance Notice 2025-19, CY 2026 Municipal Levy Cap Referendum Procedures

rows.section: New Jersey real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Realty Transfer Fee (standard rates)
rows.value: Graduated per $500 of consideration: up to $350,000 total, $2.00 / $3.35 / $3.90 per $500; above $350,000 total, $2.90 to $6.05 per $500 by bracket
rows.note: Paid by the seller when the deed is recorded. Reduced rates apply for senior citizens, blind or disabled sellers and low/moderate income housing.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: Realty Transfer Fee (last updated 11/13/26)

rows.section: New Jersey real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Graduated Percent Fee on sales over $1 million
rows.note: Replaced the 1% buyer-paid fee from July 10, 2025; now paid by the seller. Applies to residential, farm with residence, commercial (Class 4A) and co-op units.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: Realty Transfer Fee (last updated 11/13/26)

rows.section: New Jersey real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Seller (grantor) pays both the Realty Transfer Fee and the Graduated Percent Fee
rows.note: The over-$1 million fee shifted from buyer to seller under P.L. 2025, c. 69, effective July 10, 2025.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation memorandum: Amendments to Graduated Percent Fee on Realty Transfers over $1 Million (July 2, 2025)

rows.section: New Jersey real estate transfer tax
rows.label: Main exemptions
rows.value: Consideration under $100; transfers to or from government; deeds securing a debt; transfers between spouses or parent and child; estate distributions; deeds within 90 days of a divorce decree; and others
rows.note: Exemptions must be claimed on Form RTF-1.
rows.source_title: NJ Division of Taxation: Realty Transfer Fee (last updated 11/13/26)
